pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches on the neck transitioning to smaller, more fragmented geometric shapes on the lower flank. Edges exhibit soft pixel gradients with moderate angularity at vertices.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstices forming a complex topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial. Corridor thickness is relatively consistent across the mid-section with minor thinning on the upper neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder. The 1D contour consists of fine, vertical hair clusters creating a rhythmic serrated edge against the background.
